en: The Dyad of Fetters and Association with Fetters (Saññojana-saññojana-sampayutta-duka)
Dependent on a state that is both not a fetter and dissociated from fetters, there arises a state that is both not a fetter and dissociated from fetters,

by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is both not a fetter and dissociated from fetters, there arises a state that is dissociated from fetters but not a non-fetter, by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is both not a fetter and dissociated from fetters, there arise states that are both not a fetter and dissociated from fetters,
as well as states that are neither a fetter nor dissociated from fetters, by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is both dissociated from fetters and neither a fetter nor dissociated from fetters, [there arise] states that are dissociated from fetters...
And conditioned by a state that is both dissociated from the fetters and not a fetter, a state that is both dissociated from the fetters and a fetter arises by way of root-condition.
Conditioned by a state that is both dissociated from the fetters and not a fetter, a state that is neither dissociated from the fetters nor a fetter arises by way of root-condition.
Conditioned by a state that is both dissociated from the fetters and not a fetter, a state that is neither dissociated from the fetters nor a fetter... [arises] by way of root-condition.

And by way of the root condition, there arise states that are both dissociated from the fetters and not dissociated from the fetters, as well as states that are both dissociated from the fetters and not dissociated from the fetters,
and are neither consciousness nor fetters; and states that are both dissociated from the fetters and not dissociated from the fetters, and are neither consciousness nor fetters.
Dependent on a state that is neither a fetter nor dissociated from fetters, there arises a state that is neither a fetter nor dissociated from fetters by way of root condition ...
Nine under root; ... pe ... nine under non-disappearance. (Full detail in all cases.)
